summary: T-0186 StoreMode pin: additive storeMode?='auto'|'memory' parameter threaded through createJobStore/createTimerStore/createOutboxStore/createServer/handleRequest. Fixes externalWorker.e2e.test.ts (18 tests) and health.test.ts (4 tests) failing under ambient DATABASE_URL (pre-existing gap from T-0185 review §3). Production path ('auto'/undefined) is byte-for-byte preserved — no call site in src/index.ts or src/main.ts is modified. Router cache keyed by mode (_routerCache: Partial<Record<StoreMode, Router>>) prevents cross-mode contamination. Both scenarios green: Scenario A (no env) 1332/1338, Scenario B (DATABASE_URL=postgres://...) 1332/1338. tsc 0 errors, eslint 0 errors (2 pre-existing console warnings), fitness 409 PASS 0 FAIL. Nit R-1 closed (stale count 22→18 in spec). Nit R-2 documented (explicit store + storeMode='memory' asymmetry — no call sites hit this case).
